"We used to move faster before the pandemic,"

I've heard this 10+ over the past few weeks.

Why?

The lethargy of remote work is palpable. There's no electricity, spirit, comradery, and magic.

This will be the story of winners and losers in 2023—velocity always wins.

Truth is dead for for Gen Z (and millennials too).

We are cynical because we have to be in the era of disinformation, rampant lies, deepfakes, etc.

One vision for AI I am hopeful for—AI systems that help us seek truth, and swat away the lies.

Let’s please build this 🙏
